honest_note: Edge times are derived from endpoint first-seen times, not per-transaction event times. 100% of edges have approximated timestamps. Conclusions are limited to this setting.

decomposition.claim: The title 'temporal gains are leakage' is NOT supported: removing cross-split edges improves AP, so those edges carry harmful noise rather than exploitable future labels. The paper's central claim must be revised to an evaluation-sensitivity finding.
